verdict.rationale: Framer is an AI website builder with a built-in AI agent, so a training-data opt-out is a fair question to ask of it. Nothing in the evidence pack documents a setting or policy that stops user data from being used to train AI models. The branching, password-protection and llms.txt items cover other features and do not address training-data use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
